Kb.bar_b_note: The mossy shell and green skin are on-style, but the turtle stands no taller than the 1.80 m trainer and the faint reads (A: tipped edge-on in faint mid; B: a slightly lowered standing pose) fall short of Palworld-class readability.

Tv.bar_b_note: The tall coiled serpent silhouette with its cyan body and pink fin frills reads instantly and has Palworld-class appeal; the coil hiding the trainer in the standing frame is the main blemish.

Rs.bar_b_note: The otter silhouette and the ridden pose work, but the coat (flat, uniform cyan on B, only a small pale throat patch on A) lacks the fur depth and value break of the style-bar wolf and bear.

Lz.bar_b_note: The serpent's tall readable S-silhouette and saturated cyan/pink colouring carry it; the trainer half-hidden behind the coil in standing is the only read problem.

Qp.bar_b_note: A's furry boar is close to the naturalistic bar but is trainer-height, has blobby yellow back spots and floats in faint mid; B's smooth terracotta clay body with moss decals reads as a toy, not a Palworld-class creature.

Ek.bar_b_note: The white-haired elder has clear eyes, a warm readable face and a green and brown villager palette that fits the Meadows key art; its smoother, more cartoon face is the only step away from the naturalistic creature bar.

Uw.bar_b_note: A's violet storm wolf reaches the owner style bar with a strong rearing hit react, but B's faint frames break into a white body with black blotches and its hit react barely differs from standing, which sinks the set.

Ur.bar_b_note: B's larger, fully wrapped recipe text reads at a glance, but the action prompts are still small grey-white glyphs with no teal emphasis, and the murky night-rain world behind the panel has no Valheim-class light.

top_changes.change: Fix the Uw side-B faint material (white body with black blotches) and its flat hit react. Make every creature's faint pose readable and grounded: Kb turtle resting cleanly on its back, Qp boar on its side with its shadow in contact.
Scale every creature above the 1.80 m trainer (Kb turtle, Qp boar, Rs otter are at or near trainer height). Give coats a matte, darker-back and lighter-belly value break with rim light (Rs B, Qp A).
Replace the Qp side-B clay/terracotta boar with a naturalistic fur-and-tusk model at the owner style-bar level.
